name: Megazinee
description: Live CPU, RAM, disk and containers of your SSH servers, with 24 hour disk trends, in a sidebar panel and the status bar.

settings.title: Machines to watch
settings.description: One machine per line as name=ssh-target, for example web-01=ubuntu@10.0.0.1. The machine must accept your SSH key without a password prompt.

settings.title: Seconds between samples
settings.description: Each machine keeps one SSH connection and is sampled again after this many seconds. Docker and systemd are sampled about every 15 seconds.

settings.title: Desktop notifications
settings.description: Notify when a machine is offline for 30 seconds, disk or RAM reaches 80%, CPU stays at 80% for a minute, or a container is unhealthy or restarting.

settings.title: Path to ssh
settings.description: Leave empty to use Git for Windows' ssh when present, else ssh on PATH.
